order by a.updated_at desc limit #{limit} offset #{offset}

select a.id, a.asset_no, a.name, a.type, a.status, a.owner_id, u.display_name as owner_name, a.location, a.spec, a.remark, a.purchase_date, a.created_at, a.updated_at, a.version from biz_asset a left join sys_user u on u.id = a.owner_id where a.id = #{id} and a.deleted = 0 limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into biz_asset ( id, asset_no, name, type, status, owner_id, location, spec, remark, purchase_date, version, created_at, updated_at, deleted ) values ( #{id}, #{assetNo}, #{name}, #{type}, #{status}, #{ownerId}, #{location}, #{spec}, #{remark}, #{purchaseDate}, #{version}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}, 0 )
mapper.update: update biz_asset set name = #{name}, type = #{type}, status = #{status}, owner_id = #{ownerId}, location = #{location}, spec = #{spec}, remark = #{remark}, version = version + 1, updated_at = #{updatedAt} where id = #{id} and version = #{version}
